privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.section1Body: Power Roster is a strength coaching (powerlifting) platform that lets coaches manage athletes, programs, video feedback and communications. The data controller is the publisher of Power Roster.

section2Items.account: Account data: name, email address, role (coach or athlete).
section2Items.profile: Profile data: date of birth, height, sex, weight class, injury history, biography.
section2Items.training: Training data: sessions, personal records, competitions, readiness indicators, body weight.
section2Items.content: Content: video feedback, annotations, text and audio messages.
section2Items.technical: Technical data: login logs required for security.
section2Items.usage: Anonymized or account-linked usage data: page views, in-app actions (via PostHog EU).

privacy.section3Body: Data is processed to provide the coaching service (contract performance), ensure platform security (legitimate interest) and, where applicable, based on your consent. Health-related data (injuries) is only processed in the sporting follow-up you entrust to your coach.
privacy.section4Body1: An athlete’s data is accessible to the coach(es) they are linked to. We sell no data. Some technical processors host data on our behalf (hosting, video storage, email) in compliance with GDPR.
privacy.section4Body2: We use PostHog (hosted in the European Union) for product analytics: pages viewed, in-app actions and, where applicable, session recordings with input masking. This data is only used to improve the service and is retained per PostHog’s retention policy.
privacy.section5Body: Data is kept while your account is active. You can delete your account at any time, which permanently erases your data and media.
privacy.section6BodyBefore: Under GDPR you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability. From your
privacy.section6BodyAfter: area you can export your data as JSON and delete your account. For any other request, contact support.
privacy.section7Body: Passwords are hashed, access is scoped by role and coach–athlete relationship, and regular backups are performed.
